SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT A.KEP_SEQ FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_IT_SEND A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.BUYER IN (SELECT BUYER FROM IF_ADMIN WHERE BUYER_ID = 'ISDS') AND IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY KEP_SEQ
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT BUYER, QUOTATION_NO, QUOTATION_SEQ, 1 AS REVISION, BUYER_ITEM_NO, DESCRIPTION, SPECIFICATION, UNIT_MEASURE, MAKER_NAME, MODEL_NO, CATEGORY1 , CATEGORY2, CATEGORY3, UNIT_PRICE, DATA01 AS ADD_USER_ID FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_IT_SEND A WHERE 1 = 1 AND KEP_SEQ = '$G_RS.KEP_SEQ$'
UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_IT_SEND A SET IF_FLAG = 'Y' , IF_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE 1 = 1 AND KEP_SEQ = '$G_RS.KEP_SEQ$'
UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_IT_SEND A SET IF_FLAG = 'E' , IF_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE 1 = 1 AND KEP_SEQ = '$G_RS.KEP_SEQ$'
